blocks.text: Aap jante hain ke receptors woh aaza, tissues, cells ya cells ke hisse hain jo bahar ya andar ke mahol ki tabdeeliyan (stimuli) pakarte hain aur apne sath jure sensory neurons mein nerve impulses paida karte hain. Hum zaiqe (taste), boo (smell), chhoone (touch) aur dard (pain) ke receptors parhenge.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: Sab se saada receptors free nerve endings (khule nerve sire) hain jo mukhtalif stimuli par jawab dete hain, maslan darja-e-hararat ki tabdeeli aur extracellular fluid ke kimiyai madde.

blocks.prompt: Tamam receptors stimulus ke saath kya karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Use pakar kar apne sensory neurons mein nerve impulses mein badal dete hain (transducer ka kaam).

items: Receptors stimuli pakar kar sensory neurons mein impulses banate hain; sab se saada receptors free nerve endings hain.
